mapper.insert: INSERT INTO person (id, name, nickname, birth_date, birth_year, birth_year_only, hometown, education, height_cm, weight_kg, media_dir, cover_path, cover_data, remarks) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{birthDate}, #{birthYear}, #{birthYearOnly}, #{hometown}, #{education}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{mediaDir}, #{coverPath}, #{coverData}, #{remarks})
mapper.update: UPDATE person SET name = #{name}, nickname = #{nickname}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, birth_year = #{birthYear}, birth_year_only = #{birthYearOnly}, hometown = #{hometown}, education = #{education}, height_cm = #{heightCm}, weight_kg = #{weightKg}, media_dir = #{mediaDir}, cover_path = #{coverPath}, cover_data = #{coverData}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, nickname, birth_date, birth_year, birth_year_only, hometown, education, height_cm, weight_kg, media_dir, cover_path, cover_data, remarks, created_at, updated_at FROM person WHERE id = #{id}

where.if: ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person_account a WHERE a.person_id = p.id AND (a.value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person_tag pt JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.person_id = p.id AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.nickname, p.cover_path, p.cover_data, p.birth_year_only, p.birth_date, p.birth_year, p.hometown, p.education, p.height_cm, p.weight_kg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media m WHERE m.person_id = p.id) AS media_count, (SELECT MIN(mr.meet_date) FROM meet_record mr WHERE mr.person_id = p.id) AS first_meet, (SELECT MAX(mr.meet_date) FROM meet_record mr WHERE mr.person_id = p.id) AS last_meet FROM person p
ORDER BY
COALESCE(p.nickname, '') p.updated_at media_count
(first_meet IS NULL), first_meet (last_meet IS NULL), last_meet p.created_at
ASC DESC
, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
